text:
zoe: Working on PR #5872 1 migrating streaming+pagination snippets across py/ts/go. Goal: small, copy-pasteable examples that show resume token checkpointing + a shared retry helper. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/5872

nate: Will review. Can we also clarify token TTL and how to surface a 'stale token' error? We had a support thread where users retried forever.

aj: I can add a short note and an example that checks expiry on the client side, then falls back to a fresh request if expired. For Python async I'll demonstrate an async-iterator that yields pages and writes a checkpoint file.

lee: ops ask: please add a docs-ci snippet-run job that executes the snippets harness for each language. I found a few panics last week from snippets drifting. I can add job yaml if you want.

zoe: yes please add the job. Also request: TS sample should export a small `retryWithBackoff` util instead of inline loops so the SDK examples stay readable.

maria: +1 on utility. Also small UX note: keep the TS example using async iterators (for-await-of) not callbacks, since most users are on modern Node.

docs-bot: snippet-harness/5872 1 run started

docs-bot: snippet-harness/5872 1 failed (go): examples/pagination/go/client.go:42: undefined: ResumeCursor

aj: looks like I refactored the Go type name in another commit. Fixing to `ResumeCursor` -> `ResumeToken` mismatch now. Pushing patch.

aj: (pushed) quick snippet diff for go checkpoint struct:
```
// checkpoint.go (examples/pagination/go)
package pagination

type ResumeToken struct {
    Cursor string `json:"cursor"`
    ExpiresAt int64 `json:"expires_at_unix"`
}
```

zoe: cheers. Also adding a 1-line changelog entry: "docs: clarify resume-token TTL and client-side expiry check in pagination examples"

nate: for the Python example, please show both a tiny sync wrapper and the async iterator pattern. Support folks often paste the sync call into scripts.

aj: will do. Example plan:
- py: async iterator `async for page in paginate_stream(...)` + `save_checkpoint(token)` example. then `sync_paginate(...)` wrapper.
- ts: `async function* paginate()` + `retryWithBackoff` helper file.
- go: channel-based pager + `ResumeToken` struct and small `IsExpired()` method sample.

lee: once snippets pass harness I'm happy to add the job yaml and flip to required. For now I can re-run harness manually when you want a final check.

maria: nit: add a short comment in each snippet about TTL semantics, e.g., `// resume tokens valid for ~15 minutes by default` so readers don't assume permanence.

aj: added comments and a small `IsExpired` helper in go. Re-ran locally, looks good. Pushing to PR.

docs-bot: snippet-harness/5872 1 run started

docs-bot: snippet-harness/5872 1 succeeded (py,ts,go)

zoe: great, thank you. @lee please add the job and mark as optional for now. I'll merge after CI and another quick pass from @maria.

maria: quick pass done, left two very small wording nits (one about a link to /guides/streams vs /guides/streaming).

zoe: fixed the link & pushed. merging after green CI. Thanks everyone. :tada:

[thread end]
